item.title: Farewell, My Little Island
item.description: Reflecting on four years at Hainan University as I depart, this piece records the island's climate, friendships, and daily moments, sharing the reluctance and farewell of graduation.

item.title: Hainan University Course Guide Sharing Initiative
item.description: Introduces the origins of the Hainan University Course Guide Sharing Initiative, the deployment of the MkDocs website and comment system, as well as the promotional feedback and maintenance ideas on the first day of launch.

item.title: A Long Journey of Learning
item.description: Reflecting on my journey from high school informatics competitions to Hainan University, documenting my studies, projects, and growth during university, as well as the emotional process of the recommendation for postgraduate exemption phase.

item.title: A Day Trip to My First IELTS Exam
item.description: Documenting my experience taking the first paper-based IELTS exam at Hainan University in 2021, reviewing the on-site feelings for the Speaking, Listening, Reading, and Writing sections.
